cafe.thunderbird.daisy.lounge.text: {"lexicon":1,"id":"cafe.thunderbird.daisy.lounge","description":"Daisy's lounge at thunderbird.cafe/webtiles/daisy/.","defs":{"main":{"type":"record","description":"Present while this account mingles in Daisy's lounge (an opt-in, off unless chosen; turning mingling off deletes this record). It says only that the account mingles, never when it's at the table: other mingling players see that only while both are here and one of them asks.","key":"literal:self","record":{"type":"object","required":["createdAt"],"properties":{"createdAt":{"type":"string","format":"datetime","description":"When mingling was turned on."}}}}}}
